rationale:
runtimes/csharp/main.cs: v2 Entity.entity_id is now bytes. At construction (C004), the string identifier must be UTF-8 encoded to bytes. At observation (C002), bytes must be UTF-8 decoded back to string. v1 behavior unchanged since it remains string type. The output observation key 'entity_id' retains string value as specified.
runtimes/python/main.py: Changed entity_id handling in process_entity to decode bytes to UTF-8 string for v2 observations, preserving string output. Modified constructor call to encode string to bytes for v2 entity creation. v1 behavior unchanged.
runtimes/typescript/main.ts: v2 entity_id changed from string to bytes per schema. At construction, TextEncoder encodes string to UTF-8 bytes. At observation, TextDecoder decodes bytes back to string for the entity_id JSON output key. v1 behavior unchanged. The output key remains entity_id with string value as specified.
assumptions: runtimes/csharp/main.cs: Google.Protobuf.ByteString.ToByteArray() is available for bytes fields
runtimes/csharp/main.cs: EntityId property on v2 Entity is of type Google.Protobuf.ByteString
runtimes/csharp/main.cs: The v2 schema has been regenerated with bytes field type
runtimes/python/main.py: Generated Python bindings properly handle bytes entity_id field
runtimes/python/main.py: UTF-8 encoding/decoding preserves string identifiers correctly
runtimes/python/main.py: Empty/Unicode strings round-trip properly through UTF-8 encode/decode
runtimes/typescript/main.ts: TextDecoder/TextEncoder provide UTF-8 encode/decode for valid UTF-8 round-trip
runtimes/typescript/main.ts: Generated TypeScript bindings expose entityId as Uint8Array for v2 Entity
runtimes/typescript/main.ts: Empty/Unicode/escaped text round-trips identically through encode/decode cycle
